inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Map across cytosol (ADH), microsome (CYP2E1/MEOS, fomepizole site), peroxisome (catalase) and mitochondria (ALDH): ethanol → acetaldehyde → acetate → acetyl-CoA, NADH generated at both steps, disulfiram blocking ALDH

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Integrated diagram: alcohol dehydrogenase-driven ↑NADH/NAD+ inhibits gluconeogenesis and TCA, diverts pyruvate→lactate and acetyl-CoA→ketones/fatty acid synthesis → hypoglycemia, lactic/ketoacidosis, fatty liver

notes: Both pathway figures are original KYP redraws/adaptations: the compartment map preserves the source's four compartments (cytosol ADH, microsome CYP2E1, peroxisome catalase, mitochondria ALDH) with cofactor pairs and both drug blockades; the consequences map preserves the 4A/4B markers and the stimulated-vs-inhibited legend logic.
